What you are seeing

The positions and tile names come from the selected decoded map file. Artwork mode uses the original static meshes, UV coordinates, main textures and stored tile rotations. Structural mode uses schematic markers. The original layer names are preserved.

What is still missing

The camera is approximate; textures are shown unlit, without the game’s custom shader tint. Dynamic lighting, particles, animations and script-driven changes are omitted. Some shadow and decorative components reference external or runtime-generated assets and are not rendered.

Decode evidence and downloadable data

The parser consumes the complete file and validates every tileset reference. Event markers are drawn at their stored positions; their runtime effects are not inferred. Wall records are decoded but are not drawn as verified collision shapes.
